report_topic: Performance Audit of Implementation of 74th Constitutional Amendment Act in Telangana State
observations_summary: The audit found that the implementation of the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act in Telangana State was ineffective due to delays in ULB elections, non-constitution of District Planning Committees, significant staff vacancies, and inadequate devolution of functions and financial resources, leading to deficiencies in service delivery like water supply and solid waste management. Financial issues included short releases of grants and substantial arrears in property tax and water charges.
